learnerTask: Locate morphology in a represented tissue section rather than a molecular census
accuracyGuardrails: Show represented section morphology and architecture with sampling-depth limits. Stain intensity and cell appearance are not molecule counts, complete tissue coverage or a stand-alone molecular assay.

sources.sectionsRead: Fischer: Hematoxylin and eosin staining of tissue and cell sections, complete abstract
sources.supports: Blue-purple nuclear/nucleic-acid and broad pink protein/cytoplasm/matrix staining supports morphology, not a named molecule census.
sources.limits: Abstract only, not full staining protocol or validation. No microscopy classification was executed.

sources.sectionsRead: Pathology report introduction and microscopic-description section
sources.supports: Cell shapes and architecture require represented tissue and interpretive context.
sources.limits: No full diagnostic-method review; no invasion, viability or receptor result assigned.

scope: Teaching fiction; no real scan/slide/model execution, diagnosis, clinical eligibility or benefit claim. Exact original examples and existing source/review metadata preserved.
privateAids: Source bodies, access/read-depth receipts, copied renderer, scripts and QA captures remain private and are excluded from prospective public payload.
